text.content:
The first megabuildings, and the merc bar.

Region: Watson (district C). Was: the Watson Development, part of 2045's Little China
Controlled by: Precinct 3, understaffed; Maelstrom collects tolls north of Eisenhower St after dark
The feel of it: Forty-floor megabuildings full of people whose jobs just left
Notable locations: The Afterlife (#1), Tom's Diner (#2), Riot (#3), Precinct 3 (#4), Trauma Team Tower and NC Medical Center, Bartmoss's Thumb, H10
Danger: Moderate / Combat, on watch for downgrade. SC 6 (NCPD Precinct 3, Hardened Medium). UC 4

The first megabuildings in the city went up here on Co-Prosperity Sphere money: H10 and H11, forty floors of pods, shops, gyms and clinics stacked like a city on its end. They're full; the jobs that filled them are leaving. Residents are factory workers whose factories just closed, medtechs and orderlies from NC Medical Center, the Chinese diaspora that kept the name, and mercs, because of a certain bar. An H10 pod rents at Moderate prices with a three-year waiting list that's suddenly getting shorter.

Recent History

  • 2058–2064: H10 and H11 open. Little China is the success story of the decade.
  • 2069: The Sphere's first factories close; unemployment in H10 triples in a year.
  • 2070: Precinct 3 asks for forty more officers and gets nine. The Council puts the district on downgrade watch.

Places

  • Tom's Diner (#2). SC 6. Open all night. Synthcaf, real eggs on Sundays, and a regular booth for every fixer in Watson.
  • Riot (#3). SC 5. Live music; the bands play behind a wire fence for a reason.
  • NCPD Precinct 3 (#4). SC 10. Overworked, and fond of "special details" edgerunners can buy.
  • Trauma Team Tower / NC Medical Center. SC 10: Trauma Team, Hardened Heavy. TT's second tower and headquarters, with its own NCART stop. The ER takes non-members, and makes them wait.
  • H10 Megabuilding. SC 6 inside, 4 in the lower levels. A night market on 12, a ripperdoc on 23, a Maelstrom recruiter on 3.

Getting There

NCART: Medical Center, Little China, Eisenhower St (Northern Line).

Turf

Maelstrom (north of Eisenhower St), the Mox, and the Afterlife's neutral ground.

People

  • Rogue Amendiares (Fixer 10). The Queen of the Afterlife.
  • Wei Ling Tao (Medtech 6). Runs a free clinic on H10's 23rd floor.
  • Gearbox (Tech 5). An ex-Sphere factory engineer selling the closed plants' tools to whoever's buying, mostly Maelstrom.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.08
